card.name: Digits and units in lab thresholds
card.fires_on: Digits inside a number, or the unit right after it, in lab-value cutoffs such as iPTH, ferritin, calcium or anti-FXa levels. It is strongest at the next-to-last digit or at the unit pg or mg.

modes.label: Digit inside a threshold
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a lab-value number, often followed by a unit like pg/mL or ng/mL.
modes.example: Adynamic bone disease may develop if iPTH levels are suppressed below 10<<0>> pg/mL.

modes.label: Unit after a number
modes.description: The unit word such as pg or mg right after a lab number or dose.
modes.example: Less than or equal to 500<< pg>>/mL 1 mcg 2 mc
